scope_limits.installation_check: The skill registered in the available-skills catalog and all resources listed above were accessible.
documented_workflow: Establish authorized scope, acceptance criteria, configuration, and tool capabilities.
Validate configuration and plan an explicit journey/language/profile/country matrix.
Execute authorized checks and preserve observations, attempts, and evidence.
Triage demonstrated defects into reproducible tickets with severity and acceptance criteria.
Validate structured results and derive consistent report, CSV, and evidence exports.
Retest in a new campaign while preserving original history.
scope_limits.actions_performed: Local file reads only; no website browsing, audit, file changes, software installation, tests, script execution, or delegation.
scope_limits.verification_limits: Schemas, helper implementation, dependencies, and runtime capabilities were not verified.
workflow_boundaries: Functional and multilingual acceptance checks; no complete SEO audit, penetration test, or accessibility/legal certification.
Missing capabilities require BLOCKED or NOT_RUN outcomes; extraction alone does not prove interaction.
Geography requires explicit scope and evidence from the same network context.
External ticket publication requires an explicit request.
Automatic export headings support English and French; narrative translation is separate.

limitation: This checks explicit invocation and resource access, not implicit selection or browser behavior.
